Outcome.DescriptionText: A Miranda-class science vessel, adrift for three weeks, answers our hail. Her crew are alive and grateful. Before the tow ships arrive her captain passes us a coded rendezvous: a Romulan officer wants to talk. Research Neutral Zone Protocols to follow this lead up.

The distress signal was a lure. Romulan warbirds decloak around the beacon and the neutral zone is suddenly very narrow. The beacon is still transmitting, so we can try again once they are dealt with.

The beacon belongs to an Orion Syndicate crew who have been working this lane for months. They sell us the real rendezvous coordinates to avoid a fight, then try to take them back. Research Neutral Zone Protocols to follow this lead up.
